user.title: Daily Hadith setup
user.description: Enter your Sunnah.com API key for a fresh random hadith every day. Leave it empty to use the shared hadith of the day instead.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Request one from Sunnah.com on GitHub (sunnah-com/api).

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Add, change or clear your Sunnah.com API key. Leave it empty to use the shared hadith of the day.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Request one from Sunnah.com on GitHub (sunnah-com/api).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Sunnah.com. Try again later, or leave the key empty.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Daily Hadith is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

init.title: Translation
init.description: Choose the language for the translation shown under the Arabic. English and Arabic are provided directly by Sunnah.com. Any other language (including Malay) is translated by your Home Assistant AI or an OpenAI-compatible API.

data_description.language: Shown as the second button on the card. Not in the list? Type its language code (for example ms, id or pt-BR).
data_description.translator: Which AI translates the hadith. Each hadith is translated once and kept for the day.

ai_task.title: Home Assistant AI Task / Assist
ai_task.description: Uses an AI you already set up in Home Assistant (AI Task or Assist with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Ollama, and others). A short test translation runs when you submit.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Leave empty to use your default AI Task or Assist agent.

openai.title: OpenAI-compatible API
openai.description: Any service that speaks the OpenAI chat completions format: OpenAI, Ollama, OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio, Cloudflare Workers AI and more. A short test translation runs when you submit.

data_description.base_url: For example api.openai.com/v1 or 192.168.1.10:11434 for Ollama.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty if your server needs none (such as a local Ollama).

error.translator_required: This language needs an AI translator. Choose AI Task / Assist or an OpenAI-compatible API.
error.translator_required_api: With a Sunnah.com API key the hadith is not from the shared feed, so Malay needs an AI translator too.
error.ai_task_unavailable: Neither AI Task nor Assist is available. Add an AI integration in Home Assistant first.
error.translation_failed: The test translation failed. Check the settings and the logs.
error.invalid_url: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.

translator_needed.title: Daily Hadith needs a translator
translator_needed.description: The translation language is set to {language}, but no AI translator is available, so only English is shown. Go to **Settings → Devices & services → Daily Hadith → Configure** and choose Home Assistant AI Task / Assist or an OpenAI-compatible API, or pick English.

reload.name: Fetch new hadith
reload.description: Fetches a new hadith now. With an API key you get a new random hadith; without one, the latest hadith of the day.

refresh.name: Fetch new hadith
refresh.description: Fetches a new hadith now. With an API key you get a new random hadith; without one, the latest hadith of the day.
